snippet.text: lemma toll_small {P:Levels G}{x:ℝ}(hp:0<x) {f:ℕ→ℝ}(ht:Ticket P 0 f):∀ᶠ i:ℕ in atTop, f i ≤ Tau P i x:=(ht _ (mul_pos hp (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<Dust))).mono fun i h=> h.2

proof_context.conclusion: toll_small shows any Ticket f is eventually at most Tau P i x for every positive x.
